declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement on behalf of Hargrove Lane LLP in support of preliminary approval. In the first round, we proposed a $35 million class fund with automatic payments to identified members, plus a separately stated $7 million fee-and-expense request subject to court approval. We specified that any reduction in fees would benefit the class. Defense counsel responded with a $30 million class fund and up to $5 million in court-approved fees and expenses, also with automatic distribution and fee reductions benefiting the class. Brightline retained the right to oppose the fee request. We accepted that counterproposal in the second round. The agreed terms contain no clear-sailing provision, and unawarded fees will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. We will file the complete negotiation transcript as ordered. Fees were discussed in our opening proposal alongside class relief, not only after class relief had been agreed.
